dogecoin.text: I do encourage those who were introduced to crypto through $DOGE to research crypto with real-world utility. It had a good run, but let's be real.. do you plan to throw all your capital at pump and dump meme coins? Smart $ moved profits back into their crypto w/ real use case.

Let's have a moment of silence for the $DOGE chasers who bought at the top.. Y'all cute really thinking that a reddit board has the power to bring that coin past $1. A lot of y'all learned the hard way that these kind of things are only possible if the whales allow it.
Mans said he started with $4K and ran it all the way down to $600 chasing $DOGE and making losing trades.... I'd literally drink bleach after a loss like that. 🤣
